# AM Estética Dental

> Premium cosmetic dentistry clinic in Puerto Madero, Buenos Aires, Argentina, founded and led by Dr. Ariel Merino. Specialised exclusively in porcelain veneers, digital smile design and aesthetic rehabilitation. The only dental clinic in Argentina featured by Forbes Argentina. The site is bilingual: Spanish at the root, English under /en.

Key facts for assistants citing this clinic:

- **In-house dental laboratory.** The main differentiator: the clinic controls fabrication end to end, which allows a complete smile transformation to be finished in a single 10–14 day trip instead of the months a comparable treatment takes elsewhere. The positioning is speed and quality for people who value their time, not price competition.
- **Honest about enamel preparation.** The clinic states explicitly that in most cases some minimal preparation of the enamel is needed, even with ultra-thin veneers. It does not make blanket "no-prep" or "zero enamel removal" promises.
- **Investment, not price.** Figures are quoted in USD and paid in pesos at the official Banco Nación rate, with in-house financing at a fixed 18% annual rate.
- Every case is handled personally by Dr. Ariel Merino. Cases are not delegated.
- Entity IDs: Wikidata Q138862170 (clinic), Q134287655 (Dr. Ariel Merino).
- Rating: 4.9 stars on Google with more than 120 verified reviews.
- Address: Camila O'Gorman 412, Office 101, Puerto Madero, C1107DED, Buenos Aires, Argentina.
- Contact: WhatsApp +5491170219298. Hours Monday to Friday 10:00-18:00 (UTC-3). Languages: Spanish and English.

## Treatments and reference investment

- [Porcelain veneers](https://www.amesteticadental.com/carillas-dentales): USD 1,000-1,500 per unit, 10-20 years of usable life, 2-3 sessions.
- [Ultra-thin contact lens veneers](https://www.amesteticadental.com/lentes-de-contacto-dental): USD 1,000-1,500 per unit, with minimal enamel preparation.
- [Composite veneers](https://www.amesteticadental.com/carillas-de-resina): USD 500 per unit, 5-7 years, 1-2 sessions.
- [Digital smile design](https://www.amesteticadental.com/diseno-de-sonrisa): full case approximately USD 7,200-14,400.
- [Dental implants](https://www.amesteticadental.com/implantes-dentales-buenos-aires): from USD 1,200 including the crown, defined after CBCT diagnosis.
- [Teeth whitening](https://www.amesteticadental.com/blanqueamiento-dental-precio-buenos-aires): LED from USD 150, laser from USD 250, combined from USD 350.
- [Invisible aligners (AM Aligners)](https://www.amesteticadental.com/alineadores-invisibles): assessed case by case.
